{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "kind": "game",
  "entry": "index.html",
  "runtime": "static-web",
  "build": null,
  "run": null,
  "assets": [],
  "declaredControls": [
    { "input": "W / A / S / D", "action": "Move (the only control — weapons fire themselves)" },
    { "input": "Arrow keys", "action": "Move; on the level-up screen, change the selection" },
    { "input": "Drag anywhere", "action": "Touch: virtual stick under your finger" },
    { "input": "1 / 2 / 3", "action": "Take that reward on the level-up screen" },
    { "input": "Click / tap a card", "action": "Take that reward" },
    { "input": "Enter / Space", "action": "Start, confirm a reward, retry after death" },
    { "input": "Escape / P", "action": "Pause" },
    { "input": "M", "action": "Toggle sound" }
  ],
  "title": "NIGHT HARVEST",
  "genre": "bullet-heaven survival roguelite",
  "resolution": { "mode": "fills the window", "cameraWorldHeight": 700, "deviceRatioCap": 2 },
  "stack": {
    "language": "javascript",
    "flavour": "vanilla ES5, no build step",
    "modules": "classic <script> tags over a single VS global namespace",
    "rendering": "one full-window HTML5 canvas 2D, plus two half-resolution lighting layers",
    "audio": "WebAudio synthesis — no audio files",
    "dependencies": [],
    "network": "none — runs from file:// or any static server"
  },
  "files": {
    "index.html": "markup and script load order",
    "css/style.css": "full-window canvas, no page chrome",
    "js/core/utils.js": "maths, seeded RNG, coordinate hash, pools, spatial hash",
    "js/core/input.js": "keyboard, pointer, virtual stick, one-step press edges",
    "js/core/audio.js": "WebAudio synth plus an ambient drone that tracks intensity",
    "js/core/art.js": "procedural sprite factory — cast, scenery, pickups, icons",
    "js/core/render.js": "canvas sizing, camera, shadow/glow lighting layers, vignette, text",
    "js/core/game.js": "state machine, rewards, y-sorted draw pipeline",
    "js/world/terrain.js": "seamless ground tiles and hash-placed infinite scenery",
    "js/world/particles.js": "sparks, blood, smoke, embers, shards, rings, numbers, light flashes",
    "js/entities/pickups.js": "xp gems with merge-on-pressure, hearts, chests, magnets",
    "js/entities/projectiles.js": "every weapon effect in one pool, with per-projectile hit lists",
    "js/entities/enemies.js": "the horde: types, crowd separation, damage, culling",
    "js/entities/player.js": "movement, stats, health, experience",
    "js/systems/weapons.js": "eight self-firing weapons and their level tables",
    "js/systems/upgrades.js": "passives and the weighted three-way offer",
    "js/systems/director.js": "population pressure, type unlocks, set pieces, bosses",
    "js/ui/hud.js": "xp bar, timer, loadout, health, boss bar, banners, touch stick",
    "js/ui/screens.js": "title, level-up cards, pause, death and victory",
    "js/main.js": "bootstrap, resize handling, fixed-step loop, headless probe",
    "README.md": "controls, design notes, performance notes",
    "tools/smoke-test.mjs": "dev-only node harness (node tools/smoke-test.mjs); not loaded by the game"
  },
  "features": [
    "Movement is the only input; all eight weapons fire on their own timers",
    "XP gems from every kill, with a three-way reward choice on every level",
    "Six weapon slots x eight levels, plus twelve passives that feed every weapon",
    "Chests from elites and bosses grant one to three upgrades instantly",
    "Difficulty is the clock: enemy health, population target and type mix all scale",
    "Set pieces — closing circles, marching walls, elite packs — punch through the pressure",
    "Bosses at 5:00, 10:00 and 15:00; the last one ends the night",
    "The play area is the whole window and re-fits live on resize or rotation",
    "Carried-lantern lighting, y-sorted depth, procedural infinite graveyard",
    "~370 enemies plus a full build at 4.1 ms median frame in Chrome"
  ]
}
Turn your device for more room to run.
